entries.result: A large swarm of rats suddenly appears, apparently running away from something.
You hear a sudden piercing cry for help.
You come across a weathered and torn photograph depicting a group of what appears to be people with fish and amphibious-like features. Roll “Confront the Incomprehensible”.
A strange and distorted sound of bells tolling echoes across the Town.
You see someone acting normally; when they realize they are being watched, they run away!
You pass a house with boarded windows. You can hear some people talking inside, but it appears to be in a language unknown, and you can't comprehend what is being said.
A tempestuous storm is forming in the Town’s outskirts. Amidst the heavy clouds and lightning, you can see winged things flying through.
You're approached by an old drunk who mutters cryptic warnings about the danger you're in by staying in the Town.
You hear an otherworldly and haunting chant.
You are approached by a person whose testimony denies everything you know so far.
An eccentric and Helpful NPC is introduced. They lead you to an isolated Location where you can talk without being watched by the townsfolk.

You see a door open, and someone you can’t see gestures at you. If you want to get closer, roll “Push Your Luck”: if you’re lucky, they pull you in before two thugs make a jump at you; if you’re unlucky, you are ambushed by the two thugs and will have to fight them.
You encounter the townsfolk in procession. Roll “Push Your Luck”: if you’re lucky, they haven’t noticed you; if you’re unlucky, they noticed you and will come to get you by night time.
